owner_creation.analysis: prompt_col: The c_int owns the display width of the prompt prefix; clear_cmd zeroes it and cmd_putstr adds measured character widths while emitting prompt text.
owner_creation.invariant: Prompt width is metadata, not an owned prompt buffer.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

aliases_escapes.analysis: prompt_col: Cursor/home/scroll routines use it as the left editing boundary; no borrow of the actual prompt bytes is retained in this number.
